text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Davpart Incorporated is constructing a 54-storey condominium building at 481 University Avenue, 481 University Avenue, 210 Dundas Street West, 70 Centre Avenue and 137 Edward Street. The site encompasses the entire block bounded by University Avenue, Dundas Street West, Centre Avenue, and Edward Street. By way of background, Toronto and East York Community Council, at its meeting on November 10, 2020, authorized the subject construction staging area on Edward Street and on Centre Avenue, from November 12, 2020, to September 30, 2026. The developer is now requesting an extension of the duration of the construction staging area on Edward Street and on Centre Avenue, as the site has experienced construction delays due to the projects extraordinary heritage…
